steps.title: Hot liquor is safe
steps.text: Clamp every hose, use gloves and eye protection, and keep children and pets clear.
steps.done_when: Hazards controlled before the HLT is heated.

steps.title: Acid and alkali handling
steps.text: Wear PPE; add acid to water, never water to acid; label every container.
steps.done_when: Spill kit and water within reach.

steps.title: Fermentation CO2 is vented
steps.text: Ventilate the fermentation space, fit a blowoff, and never seal a fermenter without an airlock.
steps.done_when: The blowoff path is open before the fermenter is sealed.

steps.title: Electrical and gas
steps.text: Use a GFCI, keep leads off the wet floor, and check gas hoses and connections.
steps.done_when: No lead or gas hazard remains.

steps.title: Glass and carboy handling
steps.text: Inspect glass for cracks and plan the carry before lifting.
steps.done_when: A safe carry plan is in place.

steps.title: Recipe solves
steps.text: Targets: {{batch.target_abv}}, {{batch.target_ibu}}, {{batch.target_srm}}, {{batch.v_ferm}}.

steps.title: Equipment matches the rig
steps.text: HLT {{equipment.max_hlt_volume_l}}, tun {{equipment.max_mash_tun_volume_l}}, kettle {{equipment.max_kettle_volume_l}}; coil floor {{equipment.hlt_coil_floor_l}}.
steps.done_when: Capacities, losses and coil floor are confirmed.

steps.title: Batch volume confirmed
steps.text: Fermenter volume {{batch.v_ferm}}.

steps.title: Capacity headroom
steps.text: Binding limit: {{solver.batch.binding_constraint}}; max feasible ABV {{solver.batch.max_feasible_abv}}.

steps.title: Water plan
steps.text: Target profile {{water.target_profile_id}}; distribution {{water.salt_distribution}}; acid {{water.acid_medium}}.
steps.done_when: Source, targets and treatment forms are confirmed.

steps.title: Yeast plan
steps.text: {{batch.yeast.name}}; attenuation cap {{batch.yeast_cap}}; range {{batch.yeast.temp_low_c}} to {{batch.yeast.temp_high_c}}.
steps.done_when: Strain, cap and temperature range are confirmed.

steps.title: Hop plan
steps.text: Boil {{batch.boil_target_ibu}}; whirlpool {{batch.whirlpool_target_ibu}}; dry hops by schedule.
steps.done_when: Shares, forms and masses are confirmed.

steps.title: Mash plan
steps.text: Dough-in {{mash.dough_in_target_temp_c}}; strike {{mash.strike_water_temp_c}}; sparge {{batch.sparge_water_temp_c}}; total {{mash.total_time_min}}.
steps.done_when: Rests, temperatures and total time are confirmed.

steps.title: Checklist level chosen
steps.text: Selected level: {{batch.checklist_level}}.
steps.done_when: The plan is printed at the selected level.

steps.title: Diagnostic record
steps.text: Record every expected intermediate, assumption, tolerance and model caveat.

steps.title: Ingredients present and weighed
steps.text: Grist, hops, yeast, salts, acid, sugar and SMB are present and weighed.

steps.title: Yeast viable and sufficient
steps.text: Starter or rehydration plan is ready.

steps.title: Mill the grain
steps.text: Crush to the intended gap; husks intact, no flour.

steps.title: Weigh the salts
steps.text: Mash and sparge salts/acid weighed separately and labelled.
steps.done_when: Both doses are bagged and labelled.

steps.title: Weigh the hops
steps.text: Boil, whirlpool and dry-hop charges labelled with time and variety.
steps.done_when: Every charge is bagged and labelled.

steps.title: Weigh the late sugar
steps.text: Late sugar weighed and bagged.
steps.done_when: The sugar is ready for knockout.

steps.title: Prepare the water
steps.text: Filter or RO as required; SMB or campden ready.
steps.done_when: The liquor is ready to fill.

steps.title: Record the lots
steps.text: Malt lot/moisture, hop lot/alpha, yeast lot and water report date.

steps.title: Clean and sanitise cold side
steps.text: Fermenter, chiller, hoses, valves and airlock.

steps.title: Verify the vessels
steps.text: Confirm HLT, tun and kettle volumes and dead spaces.
steps.done_when: The rig matches the equipment profile.

steps.title: Calibrate instruments
steps.text: Calibrate the thermometer and pH meter.

steps.title: Check heat and plumbing
steps.text: Heat source, pump, hoses, clamps and gas.
steps.done_when: The rig is ready to heat.

steps.title: Measure the losses
steps.text: Measure actual dead space and transfer losses.
steps.done_when: The losses are recorded for the next brew.

steps.title: Vessels fit the batch
steps.text: HLT fill {{batch.hlt_starting_volume_l}}; pre-boil {{solver.batch.v_pre_boil}}; mash {{mash.mash_phase_volume_l}}.
steps.done_when: HLT within capacity and above coil floor; kettle and tun fit.

steps.title: All boundaries solve
steps.text: Batch, water and hop boundaries complete.
steps.done_when: No boundary error or blocking finding.

steps.title: Mash thickness
steps.text: {{solver.batch.mash_thickness_l_per_kg}} within the rig floor and process ceiling.

steps.title: Water targets
steps.text: Calcium floor {{water.calcium_floor_ppm}}; target {{water.target_mash_ph}}.

steps.title: Doses present
steps.text: Hop masses and water doses are present.

steps.title: Expected stage values
steps.text: Use the diagnostic appendix for the expected volumes, gravities and temperatures.

steps.title: Brew day setup
steps.text: Fill the HLT to {{batch.hlt_starting_volume_l}}; add SMB; heat to strike.
steps.done_when: The HLT is at strike temperature.

steps.title: Heat the sparge liquor
steps.text: Heat the HLT to {{batch.sparge_water_temp_c}}. This is a target; heating is not modelled.
steps.done_when: The HLT is at the sparge target.

steps.title: Re-sanitise the chiller
steps.text: If the chiller has been sitting, sanitise it again.
steps.done_when: The chiller and line are sanitised.

steps.title: Record HLT actuals
steps.text: Record the actual HLT volume and temperature.

steps.title: Dough-in / underlet
steps.text: Dose the dry grist, then underlet {{solver.batch.cascade.v_strike}}.

steps.title: Dough-in temperature
steps.text: Mash at {{mash.dough_in_target_temp_c}}.
steps.done_when: The mash is within 1 C of the target.

steps.title: Mash pH
steps.text: Target {{water.target_mash_ph}}; band 5.2 to 5.6 at 20 C.
steps.done_when: The mash pH is in band.

steps.title: Hold the rests
steps.text: Hold each enabled rest at its temperature and duration.

steps.title: Ramp the mash
steps.text: Ramp at {{equipment.mash_heating_rate_c_per_min}}; total ramp {{mash.ramp_time_min}}.
steps.done_when: The ramp reaches each rest temperature.

steps.title: Mash-out
steps.text: Heat to {{mash.enabled_max_temp_c}} for 10 min.

steps.title: Vorlauf
steps.text: Recirculate until the runoff runs clear.

steps.title: Conversion check
steps.text: Iodine test negative or refractometer stable.

steps.title: Record the mash
steps.text: Record the actual rest temperatures and times.

steps.title: First runnings
steps.text: Drain the first runnings; expect {{solver.batch.cascade.v_run1}}.
steps.done_when: The first runnings are drained and measured.

steps.title: Top up the HLT
steps.text: Top up the HLT to {{solver.batch.hlt.v_hlt_target}}; heat to {{batch.sparge_water_temp_c}}.
steps.done_when: The HLT holds the target volume.

steps.title: Dose the HLT
steps.text: Add the sparge salts and acid to the HLT.

steps.title: Batch sparge
steps.text: Add {{solver.batch.cascade.v_sparge}}; stir; rest; drain the second runnings.

steps.title: Pre-boil
steps.text: Expect {{solver.batch.v_pre_boil}} at {{solver.batch.cascade.sg_pre_boil}}.
steps.done_when: Pre-boil volume and gravity are measured.

steps.title: Compare the runnings
steps.text: Compare first and second runnings against the plan.
steps.done_when: The runnings match the expected volumes and gravities.

steps.title: Leave the losses
steps.text: Leave the tun dead space and transfer loss behind.
steps.done_when: The losses are left by design.

steps.title: Record the lauter
steps.text: Record the runnings gravity, extract and lauter efficiency.

steps.title: Start the boil
steps.text: Rolling boil for {{batch.boil_time_min}}; expect {{batch.delta_v_evap}} boil-off.
steps.done_when: A rolling boil is reached and the timer is started.

steps.title: Add the boil hops
steps.text: Add each boil charge at its scheduled time.

steps.title: Add the late sugar
steps.text: Add the late sugar at knockout.

steps.title: Flameout
steps.text: Post-boil {{solver.batch.cascade.v_post_boil}} at {{solver.batch.sg_post_boil}}.
steps.done_when: Post-boil volume and gravity are measured.

steps.title: Monitor the boil-off
steps.text: Compare the boil-off with {{batch.boil_off_rate_l_per_hr}}.

steps.title: Form the trub cone
steps.text: Whirlpool before transfer.

steps.title: Record the boil
steps.text: Record the hop lot alphas and actual addition times.

steps.title: Whirlpool
steps.text: Add the whirlpool charges and rest to knockout.
steps.done_when: Every whirlpool charge is added and the rest is complete.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Chill to the pitch temperature.
steps.done_when: The wort is at pitch temperature.

steps.title: Transfer to the fermenter
steps.text: Leave the trub and kettle dead space; package {{batch.v_ferm}}.
steps.done_when: The wort is in the fermenter.

steps.title: Aerate
steps.text: Aerate or oxygenate the wort.

steps.title: Pitch the yeast
steps.text: Pitch {{batch.yeast.name}} at the target temperature.

steps.title: Seal and label
steps.text: Fit the airlock or blowoff, seal the fermenter and label the batch.
steps.done_when: The fermenter is sealed and labelled.

steps.title: Measure the OG
steps.text: Expected {{solver.batch.sg_post_boil}}; volume {{batch.v_ferm}}.

steps.title: Record the transfer losses
steps.text: Record kettle dead space, transfer and trub.

steps.title: Record knockout
steps.text: Record the cooling curve, chill time and pitch temperature.

steps.title: Clean the hot side
steps.text: Clean the kettle, tun, HLT, hoses and chiller.

steps.title: Store the gear
steps.text: Dispose of the spent grain and hops; clean and dry the site.

steps.title: Record the day
steps.text: Record the actuals and deviations.

steps.title: Update the rig
steps.text: Record losses and efficiency for the next brew.

steps.title: Fermentation started
steps.text: Check for krausen or gravity movement within 24 to 48 hours.

steps.title: Hold the temperature
steps.text: Hold within {{batch.yeast.temp_low_c}} to {{batch.yeast.temp_high_c}}.

steps.title: Monitor fermentation
steps.text: Track gravity and krausen through fermentation.

steps.title: Diacetyl rest
steps.text: Run a diacetyl rest if the strain or style needs it.

steps.title: Dry hop
steps.text: Add at the recorded event and remove at the recorded endpoint.

steps.title: Cold crash
steps.text: Cold crash without suck-back.
steps.done_when: The beer is cold and clear.

steps.title: FG stable
steps.text: Expect {{batch.realized_fg}}; stable over 2 to 3 days.

steps.title: Record fermentation
steps.text: Record the gravity and temperature log.

steps.title: Sanitise packaging
steps.text: Sanitise the packaging equipment.

steps.title: Transfer the beer
steps.text: Transfer off the yeast and trub.
steps.done_when: The beer is off the yeast.

steps.title: Carbonate
steps.text: Prime or force carbonate to your target. Carbonation is not modelled.

steps.title: Minimise oxygen
steps.text: Use a closed transfer where possible.

steps.title: Seal and label
steps.text: Seal and label the package.
steps.done_when: The package is sealed and labelled.

steps.title: Condition
steps.text: Condition at the intended time and temperature.

steps.title: Record packaging
steps.text: Record yield, FG, ABV and carbonation.

steps.title: Taste
steps.text: Taste and record sensory notes.

steps.title: Compare with the plan
steps.text: Compare actual efficiency and attenuation with the prediction.

steps.title: Clean and store
steps.text: Clean and store the equipment.

steps.title: Update the recipe
steps.text: Record what to change next time.
